name: wikijs
description: Query, search, publish, and update pages on the internal Wiki.js knowledge base via its GraphQL API.

interface.shortDescription: Query, search, publish, and update internal Wiki.js pages.
interface.longDescription: Operate the internal Wiki.js knowledge base through its GraphQL API: search and read ops documentation (deployments, servers, databases, middleware), publish new pages, and update existing ones. Requires the WIKIJS_TOKEN environment variable.
defaultPrompt: Use wikijs:wikijs to search the internal wiki for kafka deployment info.
Use wikijs:wikijs to publish these deployment notes to the wiki under app/.
